categories.main_business_segments: AVIC Airborne Systems Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the aerospace manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, development, production, sales, and service of airborne electronic systems, flight control systems, and electromechanical systems for various aircraft and engines. The company also engages in aerospace, shipbuilding, electronic information products, automotive parts and systems, industrial automation and control equipment, intelligent systems, mechanical manufacturing equipment, software information products, and related services. Its business spans defense aviation, civil aviation, modern industries, and international markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced aerospace technologies including avionics, flight control, electromechanical systems, inertial navigation, radar and fire control systems, electronic countermeasures, and integrated lighting and instrumentation. It employs comprehensive R&D and manufacturing capabilities with system-level, device-level, and component-level product chains, supported by multiple key experimental platforms and certifications such as CTSOA and STC. Production methods emphasize quality management, flexible manufacturing systems, and information technology integration to handle multi-variety, small-batch production efficiently.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are defense and civil aviation sectors, including military aircraft manufacturers and operators, domestic civil aircraft programs like the C919 and C929, and related aerospace equipment users. The company also serves industries in automotive manufacturing, industrial automation, and intelligent systems. Major markets are domestic China with growing international exposure, particularly in aerospace and defense sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and registered offices in Beijing and multiple subsidiaries across provinces such as Shaanxi, Sichuan, Hubei, Guizhou, Henan, and Jiangsu. It also has investments and operations in Thailand and other international locations. Overseas assets are minimal, accounting for approximately 0.10% of total assets.
categories.supply_chain_position: AVIC Airborne Systems functions primarily as a midstream and downstream manufacturer and system integrator within the aerospace supply chain. It develops and produces key airborne electronic and electromechanical systems that are integrated into aircraft and engine platforms, serving as a major supplier to aircraft manufacturers and defense customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation driven by aerospace technology breakthroughs, focusing on digitalization, intelligent upgrades, and new material applications. It actively supports national aerospace strategic initiatives, including military-civil integration and the development of domestic civil aircraft. R&D efforts emphasize new product certifications, quality improvements, lifecycle service systems, and expansion into emerging aerospace technologies such as quantum science, AI, and nanotechnology. It also pursues professional integration and industrial restructuring to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aerospace products and systems, including defense and civil aviation equipment, automotive parts, and industrial automation products. The company also earns income from providing related services such as maintenance, upgrades, and technical support. Additional revenue streams include investment income from equity holdings and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As a leading domestic supplier of airborne systems in China, AVIC Airborne Systems holds a strong market position with a comprehensive product portfolio and significant market share in both defense and civil aviation sectors. It competes with other major aerospace manufacturers and system integrators domestically and internationally, leveraging its integration within the AVIC Group and its technological advantages to maintain leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 29.01 billion, a 4.63% increase over the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.89 billion, up 39.62%. Total assets reached RMB 73.52 billion, growing 13.6% year-over-year, with net assets attributable to shareholders at RMB 36.08 billion, up 62.43%. The company has shown steady growth supported by strategic mergers, capital increases, and enhanced operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AVIC Airborne Systems emphasizes its comprehensive aerospace product system, broad application fields, and strong R&D and innovation capabilities as key differentiators. It offers integrated solutions across avionics, flight control, and electromechanical systems with high reliability and quality, supported by advanced experimental platforms and certifications. The company’s close alignment with national aerospace strategies and its ability to provide lifecycle service and flexible production systems further enhance its competitive edge.
